name: Cream Serif
tagline: Warm cream, a chunky serif with one coral italic word, soft paper cards and a highlighter sweep.
description: Friendly editorial look: warm cream, a big Fraunces headline that de-blurs with one coral italic word, soft paper cards with a warm shadow, a coral highlighter sweep, and a tilted coral number that slams in. The preview is a developer-tool launch: a question, a search demo, a before-and-after comparison and a logo with an install command.

display.usage: Headlines 76–150px tracking -0.02em; one coral italic word per line; stat 260px

mono.usage: File paths and the install pill, 26–30px

transitions: hard cut between scenes; the next headline rises 30px
headlines and logos resolve from blur (8–26px) instead of fading
textAnimations: input text types character by character with a coral caret
result rows rise in sequence, the first gets a coral-tint highlighter sweep
stat slams in tilted -8° from scale 1.7; the old value is struck through

rhythm.notes: Beats of ~2s with hard cuts; headlines resolve from blur in under a second.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Cream ground #f3ede2 with a soft radial lightening (#f8f3ea centre → #ebe3d4 edge). Surfaces are #fffaf2 with 26px radius, a #e2d9c9 hairline and a warm low shadow (0 30px 80px rgba(90,60,30,0.14)). Ink #1d1b18, muted #8f877b. No pure white or black backgrounds.
- Headlines in Fraunces 800, 76–150px, tracking -0.02em; exactly one word per headline in coral #ec5b3c Fraunces 700 italic.
- Titles, logos and big words resolve from blur (blur 8–26px and scale 1.08 → sharp, power3.out, ~0.6–0.95s) instead of fading; after a hard cut the next headline rises 30px.
- Show the subject doing one concrete thing rather than abstract decoration: e.g. input typing with a coral caret, results rising in sequence, the key one swept by a coral-tint #fbe3d9 highlighter (power2.inOut).
- Prove a claim with one number: a before/after bar pair (ink vs coral, expo.out) and a big coral figure (~260px) that slams in tilted -8° from scale 1.7 with back.out(2.2) while the old value is struck through. Add a small muted note saying what was measured.
- Inter 400–600 for UI text (24–34px); JetBrains Mono 500 (26–30px) for code, paths or commands, set in a dark #1d1b18 pill with cream text.
- Beats of ~2s with hard cuts. A closing line can split in two, with the second half in coral italic.
- Avoid cold greys, neon, heavy gradients and more than one italic word per headline.
example: The preview asks 'What are we shipping?', then a search card types a query and finds code files, two bars compare cost before and after with a coral −42%, and it ends on a logo with an install command. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
